terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern the use of the Beautiro medical tourism concierge service (the "Service") operated by Beautiro Co., Ltd. (주)뷰티로 (the "Company").
terms.contactNote: Questions about these Terms: Beautiro customer care (WhatsApp) or privacy@beautiro.com

sections.title: 1. Purpose
paragraphs: These Terms set forth the conditions and procedures for using online consultation, booking facilitation, transport, interpretation, and related medical tourism information services provided by the Company.

sections.title: 2. Definitions
paragraphs: "User" means any member or non-member who uses the Service under these Terms.
"Partner clinic" means a hospital, clinic, or medical provider that delivers medical services under a separate agreement with the Company.
"Concierge services" means support such as consultation intake, scheduling, transport, interpretation, and payment guidance during medical travel.

sections.title: 3. Posting and amendment
paragraphs: The Company posts these Terms on the Service.
The Company may amend these Terms within the scope permitted by applicable law and will announce the effective date and reasons in advance.
Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the amended Terms.

sections.title: 4. Services provided
paragraphs: The Company provides medical tourism information, consultation and booking intake, partner clinic matching, and concierge support.
The Company does not perform medical acts; diagnosis, treatment, and procedures are the responsibility of partner clinics.
The Service may be temporarily suspended due to maintenance, force majeure, or technical issues.

sections.title: 5. User obligations
paragraphs: Users must not provide false information or misuse another person's identity.
Users must comply with applicable laws, these Terms, and service notices.
Users must accurately disclose health conditions and travel requirements (passport, visa, etc.) when booking.

sections.title: 6. Company obligations
paragraphs: The Company strives to provide the Service in a stable and continuous manner.
The Company protects personal data in accordance with its Privacy Policy.
The Company will address legitimate complaints without undue delay.

sections.title: 7. Booking and cancellation
paragraphs: Consultations and bookings are accepted via the website, WhatsApp, and other channels provided by the Company.
Confirmation, schedule, and fees depend on partner clinic policies and mutual agreement.
Cancellation, changes, and refunds follow partner clinic rules and package notices; the Company acts as facilitator.

sections.title: 8. Fees and payment
paragraphs: Fees for services, procedures, and add-ons are based on prior notice.
Payment methods, currency, exchange rates, and fees follow individual guidance and applicable law.
The Company will not charge fees without prior user consent.

sections.title: 9. Disclaimer
paragraphs: The Company is not liable for medical outcomes, efficacy, or side effects of partner clinics.
The Company is not liable for damages beyond reasonable control, including natural disasters, war, or partner disruptions.
Medical and pricing information on the Service is for reference; partner clinics provide final confirmation.

sections.title: 10. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Content, logos, and designs on the Service belong to the Company or rightful owners.
Users may not copy, distribute, or commercially use such materials without prior written consent.

sections.title: 11. Dispute resolution
paragraphs: Disputes shall first be resolved through good-faith negotiation.
If unresolved, disputes shall be governed by applicable law; courts at the Company's principal place of business shall have jurisdiction.

sections.title: Supplementary provisions
paragraphs: These Terms take effect on August 4, 2026.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Beautiro Co., Ltd. (주)뷰티로 (the "Company") values your privacy and complies with applicable data protection laws.
privacy.contactNote: Privacy inquiries: privacy@beautiro.com · Beautiro customer care (WhatsApp)

sections.title: 1. Personal data collected
paragraphs: The Company may collect the following data to provide the Service.
Required: name, contact (phone/WhatsApp), email, consultation/booking details, preferred dates
Optional: nationality, language preference, passport/visa information, transport/interpreter requests
Automatic: access logs, IP address, cookies, device information, usage records

sections.title: 2. Purposes of use
paragraphs: Medical tourism consultation, booking, and scheduling
Partner clinic matching and concierge services (transport, interpretation, payment guidance)
Customer support, complaints, and notices
Service improvement, analytics, and fraud prevention
Compliance with legal obligations

sections.title: 3. Retention period
paragraphs: Data is deleted without delay when the purpose is fulfilled.
Where required by law, data may be retained for the statutory period.
Examples: contract records 5 years, complaints 3 years, access logs 3 months where applicable.

sections.title: 4. Third-party provision
paragraphs: The Company does not provide personal data to third parties without consent, except as required by law.
With consent, data may be shared with partner clinics and transport/interpreter partners as needed to fulfill bookings.
Recipients, purposes, items, and retention periods are disclosed in advance.

sections.title: 5. Processing delegation
paragraphs: The Company may delegate tasks to specialized vendors (e.g., hosting, messaging, payment).
Delegates and tasks are disclosed in this Policy and managed under applicable law.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, correction, deletion, or restriction of your personal data.
Contact privacy@beautiro.com or customer care; the Company will respond without undue delay.
Legal representatives may exercise rights where permitted by law.

sections.title: 7. Cookies
paragraphs: The Company may use cookies to improve the Service.
You may refuse cookies via browser settings; some features may be limited.

sections.title: 8. Security measures
paragraphs: The Company implements technical and organizational safeguards such as access control, encryption, and security programs.
Staff with data access are minimized and trained regularly.

sections.title: 9. Privacy officer
paragraphs: Privacy officer: Beautiro Co., Ltd. (주)뷰티로
Email: privacy@beautiro.com
Customer care: Beautiro WhatsApp channel

sections.title: 10. Policy changes
paragraphs: Material changes will be announced with the effective date and reasons.
The updated Policy takes effect on the announced date.
